rationale: Runtime management decides whether AWS may move the function onto a patched runtime version by itself. Under Auto it does so within days of a runtime update, which is how a vulnerability in the language runtime, in the AWS SDK bundled with it or in the underlying operating system libraries gets fixed in a function nobody redeploys. FunctionUpdate defers that to the next deployment of the function, and Manual pins the function to one runtime version until someone changes the pin, so a function that is not being worked on keeps running unpatched code indefinitely.
remediation: Set the runtime management configuration of the function to Auto, or keep the pin and add a process that moves it forward as soon as a new runtime version is published
